comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: QA signed off on mid-cycle seat add; amount ticked up as expected. Closing the story.

content.text: QA signed off on mid-cycle seat add; amount ticked up as expected. Closing the story.
Billing settings show the current plan and payment method but not what the next invoice is expected to charge. Finance owners want that figure without downloading last month’s PDF.

On the billing overview card, surface upcoming_invoice_amount and upcoming_invoice_date from the billing provider preview API, formatted in the workspace currency. Include a breakdown link to line items (seats, metered usage, credits).
Complete when the amount updates within 15 minutes of seat changes, shows “Usage still metering” when the preview is partial, and hides the block for free-tier workspaces.
